rootCause: Gradle init scripts run in included plugin builds as well as the Android root build. Included builds lack :app, and the scratch QA asset hook erroneously threw its missing-bundle message for that condition. The bundle file existed.
fix: Skip included builds with no :app; retain missing-bundle failure for the actual Android app.

secondaryFinding.rootCause: projectsEvaluated ran after AGP had snapshotted variant asset providers. :app:mergeDebugAssets remained UP-TO-DATE and APK retained the original main bundle, despite changed source-set directories.
secondaryFinding.fix: Register Debug directories when the Android application plugin is applied, before AGP builds variant asset providers.
